verification.note: Traced at HEAD 6665d0c01. useNotesTarget.ts:128,137 returns {status:'lookingUp'} while a member Target's evaluation is null, and selectedId (163-166) already equals the chosen folder id. In clips.tsx, chooseTarget (195-203) sets switchTo. switchHref (205-208) and switchSettled (209-210) both require target.status==='ready', so the effect at 211-219 does nothing and switchTo stays set. In that window effectiveParams (151-158) deletes group/sort, so readClipsView (159) shows the resolved stored view instead of the URL's readable values. When the Target becomes ready on a non-Home view, targetId===switchTo, so switchHref = clipsHref(pathname, view) and router.replace (217) overwrites the URL's group/sort. This goes against I3/I4 (history entries keep their own URL values) and I13. clipsTargetChangeOnHome.test.tsx:93-105 uses smart folder 'tag:work' and navigates only after settle(), so the in-flight window is not covered. Reaching it in normal use takes a Back or link press during the member evaluation request. That window is narrow but real.

`fullValue` is passed only at videoapp/LibraryControls.tsx:30 and readingapp/LibraryControls.tsx:155 (`fullValue={quiet}`), and ToolbarMenu.tsx:234 maps it to whitespace-nowrap vs truncate. The only jsdom test is ToolbarMenu.test.tsx:136-149, which tests the prop directly. No shelf-page jsdom test checks the class: a grep for whitespace-nowrap/truncate in component __tests__ finds none for VideoShelfPage/ReadingShelfPage. Among the e2e checks, app-header-desktop.spec.ts:101-105 (APP_PAGES includes video-shelf and reading-shelf, en only, 640px) asserts the value span's scrollWidth <= clientWidth. app-header.spec.ts:207 checks only the text content, which an ellipsis does not change. So the claim holds.

specification_compliance: I13/I4 (Clips): the Target-change rewrite can overwrite a readable URL group/sort that is reached while a member Target is being evaluated (R1 confirmed).
I20 (r2): the shelf-page quiet sort menus pass fullValue. Only a desktop e2e check (640px, en) pins it on the shelf pages.
regression_risks: Clips: navigating to a Library/shelf URL while a member Target chosen on Home is still evaluating has its group/sort replaced by the new Target's stored view.

No jsdom test asserts that the shelf-page sort value span is non-truncating. Only app-header-desktop.spec.ts:101-105 (en, 640px) checks it.
